WebSearch “фуд трак” OR “фуд тракови” Македонија — no Macedonian page using either spelling surfaced
confidence: Low-Med — подигнување, закажи нарачка, испорака, каса, понесување, мени and улична храна are confirmed on Wolt MK / Macedonian vendor pages; the food-truck word is NOT confirmed in any spelling (no Macedonian food-truck business or press page surfaced), the statutory button wording could not be read, and Pay at Hatch / plan names rest on general usage. csvRows are WebSearch (US-indexed) results for the query “систем за онлајн нарачки за фуд трак”; only English vendor pages ranked.
decisions: Food-truck word: recommend Cyrillic “фуд трак” / plural “фуд тракови” (consistent Cyrillic UI; same approach as bg-BG’s “фуд тръкове”), with Latin “food truck” as a secondary keyword in storeKeywords. Low confidence — no Macedonian usage found for either; a native or Keyword Planner check before launch is needed.

Order button: North Macedonia’s Закон за заштита на потрошувачите follows Directive 2011/83/EU, which requires the button to say the order implies an obligation to pay. Recommend “Нарачај со обврска за плаќање”; the exact statutory words were not verified — confirm against the Службен весник text.

Pay at Hatch: recommend “Плаќање при подигнување” (feature) / “Плати при подигнување” (button), built on Wolt MK’s “подигнување”. TRAP: “плаќање при испорака” / “наплата при достава” is cash on delivery — never use it.
Do not borrow Bulgarian (поръчка, фуд трък) or Serbian (поруџбина, наруџбина) forms; Macedonian is нарачка, мени, плаќање with ќ ѓ ѕ ј љ њ џ.
{country} = “Северна Македонија” (the constitutional short name since 2019); strings keep it in brackets.
